title: Record a UX contract so review has objective criteria
summary: A ux-contract artifact turns UI review from taste into checks.
procedure_steps: For UI feature work spanning several surfaces, author a ux-contract.json alongside the design spec before implementation. Useful clauses proven in the personal-pads mission: locale precedence (?lang > kb-ui-locale cookie > Accept-Language > resolveLocale), no native dialogs (route confirm()/prompt() through the shared ui:dialog component), every user-visible string in the vocabulary with en+ja minimum, shared A2UI widgets per capability (ui:sketch-board, ui:voice-input), and offline-safe stamped artifacts isolated from host UI. Acceptance then becomes mechanical: per-pad Playwright smoke with zero pageerrors, no locale leakage, unchanged server API contracts, and before/after screenshots per locale x theme. Record code review and UX review as separate evidence rounds before verification.
safety_notes: Require approval before irreversible or high-risk actions.
Capture evidence before and after the action.
escalation_conditions: Result does not match the expected state
